_comment: Schema + example for briefs/latest.json. The agent writes this file; the voice room reads `script` (falls back to `text`) — the only required field. Speak display names in `script` (e.g. 'Peter Steinberger'), not @handles. `items[].sources` should be structured objects ({author, name, id, url, aliases?}): `name` = display name for speech/UI matching, `author` = @handle for links, optional `aliases` = other spoken phrases that should still get an inline (post) tag (e.g. 'Bookface', 'Omnigent'). The live voice room passes this as GROUNDING so follow-ups use get_post on the exact source instead of a broad re-search.
title: Your X brief — Wed Jul 8
script: Good morning! Three things are moving in your feed. First, AI voice agents: Mark K says GPT-5.6 ships Thursday to Codex and ChatGPT, and folks you follow are debating whether barge-in latency matters more than model quality. Second, tech-politics: Garry Tan is pushing back hard on what he calls smear politics in SF, and it's getting traction. Want me to go deeper on any of these, pull the latest posts, or draft a reply? Interrupt me any time — say 'wrap up' when you're done.
